note.p: Ed Pope suggests: "Dr Anderson" wasn't noted in the diary till 20.11.1796, but his position in the 1796 list suggests he was the Anderson and sons at Miss Godwin's on 30.9.1795. He was probably James Anderson DNB 1739-1808, author of Recreations in Agriculture and the magazine The Bee. Three of his sons were Alexander b.1769, George 1773 - 1817 and John DNB b.1775. George Anderson's will PCC 1817 of St Martins Lane Cannon St merchant and ships chandler, brother Alexander Seton (he changed his name on receiving an inheritance from his mother's family) brother James Anderson partner Charles Laing (see Laing, Charles) dated 22.3.1815. Morning Chronicle 15.1.1817 died 10.1.at West Ham from a fall from a gig, Fellow of Linnaean Society, deep botanical research. This family seem to account for 20.7.1795 and all Andersons between 18.9.1795 and 4.4.1797. We have coded them all under this persname because they are part of the same family and not always easily distinguished.
